title: budget_aware_orchestration
goal: optimize action selection and reasoning cost inside XSHELF without allowing quality drift
constraints: preserve policy gates and quarantine behavior
prefer cheapest sufficient path, not cheapest path
keep escalation logic explicit and typed

slices.goal: add typed cost and quality metadata to next-action and action surfaces
introduce explicit reasoning-gate policy that chooses between structured action, cheap diagnosis, and deep reasoning
persist and surface compact recent execution context so unchanged state does not trigger re-derivation
add measurable efficiency and reuse metrics for budget-aware orchestration
make metric-driven recommendation bias explicit and typed on execution surfaces
apply severity-preserving, cost-aware ordering to higher-level action surfaces

milestone_summary: typed cost and quality metadata is present on next_action surfaces
reasoning gate is explicit on execution and preflight paths
recent context is persisted and reused instead of re-derived
phase7 metrics are exposed on machine-facing and text diagnostics
metric-driven bias is visible and explainable on task_execution
action surfaces now preserve severity while preferring lower-cost sufficient paths
